ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.deleteConfirm: This will remove the moi record permanently.
ledger.emptyHint: Tap "+ New moi" to record your first entry

events.title: Functions
events.emptyHint: Tap + to add a wedding, birthday, or any function you want to track moi for.

reciprocity.title: History
reciprocity.emptyHint: Search a name to see what they gave at your functions and what you gave at theirs.
reciprocity.noMatches: No one by that name yet
reciprocity.noneThisSide: Nothing recorded on this side yet
reciprocity.mergeBody: Link another spelling to "{{name}}". Their entries will be shown together. You can undo this later.
reciprocity.historyNote: This is a record of what was given, not a balance. Present-day figures are rough estimates from a bundled inflation table.

notebook.title: Notebook pages
notebook.intro: Photograph your notebook pages, then type the entries in yourself while looking at the page.
notebook.emptyHint: Add a photo of a notebook page to start transcribing it.
notebook.noPages: No notebook pages on this function yet
notebook.noEntriesForPage: Nothing recorded from this page yet
notebook.deletePageBody: The photo is deleted. The {{entries}} entries taken from it are kept.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Save everything — functions, entries, families and notebook page references — to a single file you keep yourself.
backup.notEncrypted: This file is not encrypted and anyone who opens it can read your records. Keep it somewhere private.
backup.noDateRange: No dated entries in this file.
backup.replaceBody: Every function and entry on this device is deleted first, then the file is restored. This cannot be undone.
backup.importResult: {{events}} functions and {{entries}} entries added. {{skipped}} skipped as already present.
backup.photosNotIncluded: Photos of notebook pages are not included in the backup file.

errors.MALFORMED: This file is not a valid Moi backup. It may be damaged or from another app.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This backup was made by a newer version of Moi. Update the app and try again.
errors.EMPTY: This backup has no functions or entries in it.
errors.WRITE_FAILED: The restore could not be completed. Nothing on this device was changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clearConfirm: Delete every function and moi entry? This cannot be undone.
settings.aboutBody: Moi — a local notebook for tracking wedding & function gifts. All data stays on your device.
